verdict.rationale: An official SDK is a fair thing to ask of a remote-desktop/teams platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a Teams API for deployment automation, audit logs and reporting, gated to paid tiers. A raw API is an adjacent capability, not an official SDK or client library, and nothing in the pack mentions any SDK. Probes for llms.txt, markdown API docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404, so there is not even a machine-readable spec to generate one from.
